record.field: May give approval step 1 on a vendor bill or a customer credit note: the partner, the dates, the lines and the accounts on it are right. Held by book keepers. A vendor bill cannot be posted until it carries this approval and approval step 2, so this group does not let its holder post anything on its own.

May give approval step 2 on a vendor bill or a customer credit note: we agree to it. Held by the financial director. Step 2 follows step 1 — a bill nobody has reviewed cannot be approved. A user who holds BOTH levels may clear both steps on the same bill: separation of duties is deliberately not enforced in code, and because both approvals are fields on the bill form, a bill approved twice by the same person says so on its own face.
